method: All6originalPNGs opened individually at original resolution with view_image after Chromium closed; actual pixels reviewed and hashes checked against raw report. Product logic, generated-registry context and exact collectors are bound to fresh evidence; no image/DOM/state alteration.
limitations: Only functional rules, navigation and legibility are qualified; original models, animations, numerical ranks and complete campaigns are not certified.

The barrel-only-gunfire clause is supported by fresh native combat tests plus unchanged attack/weapon multiplier in native reconstruction of actual public exports; this browser did not fabricate a damage comparison.
External source pages were not opened; visible link identity, safeURL/target/rel and contextual provenance are checked. Documentary text keeps its existing source/reference reservations.
